title: Bob Fridman
body:
Description

Bob Fridman, the master of all things mechanical and owner of The Oak Depot on Finlay Island, is the go-to guy for all your Oaklands building needs. Whether you're in need of schematics, conveyors, vehicles, or tools, his shop is open 24/7 and always fully stocked. Just don't try to haggle with him, or he'll make you do laps around Finlay Island with a conveyor belt strapped to your back.

Appearance

Bob has shaggy black hair. Atop his head rests a construction helmet. He is clad in a white coat paired with long black pants and dark-colored shoes. On his left arm is a watch.

Dialogue

"Looking to buy? Talk to me!" - Interaction Prompt

When no items are placed on the counter:

  • "Welcome to Oak Depot! We have all of the tools that you'd ever want or need, so if it catches your eye, BUY IT. PLEASE BUY IT."
    • Okay!(Ends conversation)

When an item is placed on the counter:

  • "You sure you'd like to buy [Item_Name] for a total of [Total_Price]? There are no refunds!"
    • Absolutely! (Item is purchased)
    • No thank you, I'm good. (Ends conversation)

When an item is placed on the counter, but it is too expensive:

  • "Oh... you don't have enough money. That's okay, come back again another time when you do!"
    • No thank you, I'm good. (Ends conversation)
    • Buy Money (Opens shop to Cash Section)
